1. I look forward to watching Ronway do something interesting with both Jim's Hat and Utility Belt in play.  And with access to both Displaced Armory *and* Impromptu Invention I suspect that he can roll  (or re-roll) equipment out rapidly.

2. OX/Unity - I'm not sure what this will do.  Some sort of component/golem circus I suspect.  Timeshift power a good way to put golems in play without sacrificing equipment.

3. Grysql's Naturalist deck was in play last game and was a useful tank/support deck.

4. My deck is geared towards playing one-shots.  Lots of one-shots.  With some abiltiy to roll-out some powers and turn to those if hand size gets low.  Still intended as an attack deck for the most part though.

5. The Nightmist deck should be interesting.  The Parse/Legacy/... combo did pretty well last game, so I expect that this one will as well.  However, we don't have Greatest Legacy as a character with the useful Gung-ho default power.
